title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 9
topics: Local Community · City Life · Healthy Living for Teens
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: What traditional craft is popular in your area?
What do you like most about your neighbourhood?
How do you usually get to school?
How many hours do you usually sleep every night?
Would you rather live in a big city or a small town? Why?
What problems do people in big cities often face? Why?
Is it important for teenagers to have a balanced life? Why?
Should young people learn traditional crafts? Why or why not?
A tourist asks you about an interesting place in your town. What do you tell them?
Your friend skips breakfast every day. What advice do you give?
